name: OpenGlass UI
summary: Open-source Liquid Glass React system — 40 accessible components, CSS-first.
gaps: Live demos share one catalog page (/liquid-glass#components) rather than per-route docs — same gallery-anchor pattern as glasscn.
GitHub docs/*.md are primary written API docs; marketing site is the interactive demo.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Button

demo.peerNotes: Live specimens share the catalog section on /liquid-glass#components (same pattern as glasscn single-page gallery). Import styles.css once; wrap with GlassSystemProvider.

components.copyCode:
npm install open-glass-ui react react-dom
import "open-glass-ui/styles.css";
import { Button, GlassSystemProvider } from "open-glass-ui"

<GlassSystemProvider renderer="auto" theme={{ appearance: "system" }}>
  <Button variant="primary">Create project</Button>
</GlassSystemProvider>

copyPrompt.text: Use OpenGlass UI free MIT React component `Button` (slug `button`) from the live catalog https://moelueker.com/liquid-glass#components. Install with `npm install open-glass-ui react react-dom`, then `import "open-glass-ui/styles.css"` and `import { Button, GlassSystemProvider } from "open-glass-ui"`. Component docs: https://github.com/moekoelueker/open-glass-ui/blob/main/docs/COMPONENTS.md. npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/open-glass-ui (v0.3.0). Home/demo: https://moelueker.com/liquid-glass. Repo: https://github.com/moekoelueker/open-glass-ui. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moekoelueker/open-glass-ui/main/LICENSE; Copyright (c) 2026 Moe Luker). Pricing free.
